# Junaid Hassan

> Expert Shopify & Shopify Plus developer and consultant with 10+ years of
> full-stack e-commerce development experience.

Junaid Hassan builds custom Shopify and Shopify Plus storefronts, leads
Online Store 1.0 → 2.0 and cross-platform migrations onto Shopify, and
develops custom Shopify Checkout Extensions, custom/public Shopify apps, and
the middleware that connects them to inventory, marketing, and support
systems. Additional depth in React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Nest.js, and Ruby on
Rails.

## Core capabilities
- Custom Shopify & Shopify Plus theme development, from scratch
- Online Store 1.0 → 2.0 theme migrations
- Cross-platform migrations onto Shopify
- Shopify Checkout Extensions
- Custom & public Shopify app development
- Middleware & third-party integrations (Recharge, Klaviyo, inventory
  systems, WhatsApp, push notifications, email automation, product feeds,
  SSO)
